feeds.title: DIY Daddy Blog
feeds.description: Nige is a seasoned blogger with two years of experience under his belt. Specializing in parenting and DIY, he has carved out a niche for himself as one of the Top 10 Daddy Bloggers in the UK. His blog serves as a chronicle of the joys and challenges of raising five children, offering a heartfelt account of their adventures. Nige's dedication to documenting their journey ensures that his children will have a treasure trove of memories to revisit in the future.

feeds.title: Dad Blog UK
feeds.description: Welcome to Dadbloguk.com. It's written by me, John Adams, a dad of two young daughters: Helen and Izzy. In an unusual move, I'm their main carer and run the household while my wife works full-time. This blog charts my journey as a man who has made this lifestyle choice.

feeds.title: Diary of the Dad
feeds.description: Tom Briggs is a husband of one, dad of three and a multi-award-winning parent blogger and podcaster. The mission of this blog is to share his musings about parenthood.

feeds.title: Paternal Damnation
feeds.description: I'm Robbie. A thirty-something bloke who writes about whatever he can for a living. I became a father a few years back when my son appeared. While this blog is primarily focused on parenting, I like to think that it also offers plenty of men's lifestyle content too.

feeds.title: The Yorkshire Dad
feeds.description: A Yorkshire/UK daddy blogger blogging about his experience of living with two kids under three, his love for golf, diy and life.

feeds.title: Father Figures
feeds.description: Plan your fatherhood with wisdom and practical insights. Father Figures is a personal finance publication for dads. It aims to educate and empower fathers to build a better relationship with their money. Whether you're on top of your finances or feel like you've buried your head in the sand, you will find resources for help here.

feeds.title: DaddiLife
feeds.description: We're one of the leading parenting websites for dads offering tips & advice on life, health and activities for modern day fathers. At DaddiLife we want to make the moments of joy more joyful, and your questions more quickly answered, by providing a series of articles, media and supportive community built specifically for the modern day dad.

feeds.title: Father Fitness
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Paul. Father Fitness is my fitness journey from becoming a first-time Father, to regaining my fitness. My blog holds information about health, weight loss, product reviews, nutrition, muscle, and events. I support exercise & kids offering advice on getting out and staying fit as a family.

feeds.title: Fathers Network Scotland Blog
feeds.description: Enjoy regular father-friendly news and insights from Fathers Network Scotland and our guest contributors. Fathers Network Scotland is building a father-friendly world for families, from research to national policy to local events, resources and support. We promote the physical, mental and emotional health of fathers in Scotland through our strategic partnerships with organisations working with families.

feeds.title: Dad Blog
feeds.description: Dadblog.co.uk is a mix of the author's personal fatherhood journey and contributions from parents (both mothers and fathers) among readers. Read his story about navigating life with five spirited kiddos and a menagerie of pets that keeps growing faster than can be counted.

feeds.title: Slouching towards Thatcham
feeds.description: I'm Tim. I'm a father of three two boys, one girl. This blog's about my experiences as a father, my increasingly nostalgic reflections and other random stuff that interests me from time to time.

feeds.title: The diary of Dad
feeds.description: The diary of Dad series focuses on my life as a Dad to the world's cutest little man (Opinions are my own.). The stories and emotions are real and told from the perspective of Dad. They are designed to make you smile, laugh and maybe even pity me a little.

feeds.title: The Mediocre Dad
feeds.description: A blog about Fatherhood, Camping and Other Nonsense. Whether you're a new parent, a family looking to try camping for the first time or just a lover of Lego, this blog is sure to have something for you.

feeds.title: Corporate Dad
feeds.description: Step Dad, Daddy, Husband and Full Time Worker, my blog discussing Family Life, Parenting, Reviews and Paternal Support.

feeds.title: My Hero Joshua
feeds.description: A parenting blog written about a very special little boy Joshua. Written from his Dad's perspective.

feeds.title: YOU THE DADDY
feeds.description: Insights from a London dad, on pregnancy, babies and parenthood.

feeds.title: Music Football Fatherhood
feeds.description: This blog is a home to the online community of fathers, and men looking to be fathers in the future, from the UK and beyond. We share stories from fathers through our blogs, review family days out and parenting products.

feeds.title: Inside Martyn's Thoughts
feeds.description: A Single Stay at Home Dad juggling his way through Co-Parenting, Home Education, Muscular Dystrophy, Mental health and cooking!

feeds.title: Daddacool
feeds.description: I'm Alex, the daddy to three nippers. The boy is 10 and the lass who is eight but is often mistaken for his (non identical) twin. On New Years Day 2012, Ned (AKA Danger-it's his middle name) joined us, so now we're a family of five! I write about parenting, family fun, reviews, music and other stuff.
